completeness.why: All four sites pass their own skipWeekend flag and mode field to applyWeekendRule / applyWeekendRuleToDay, which decide whether and how to move; getNextDate keeps only its own noSkipWeekend guard, a variation only that site has; the template sites' day-string conversion is their own data handling, absorbed by the day-string variant.

interface.why: applyWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend, solveMode) takes exactly the real variation and each caller maps its own mode field; the day-string wrapper is a reasonable convenience, though it re-checks skipWeekend itself to keep the untouched-day result.

disguised_duplication.where: The four copies of the skipWeekend ternary are replaced by calls; only applyWeekendRuleToDay repeats the skipWeekend test, openly, to return the original string.
